bosses.name: Mammon
bosses.strategy:
Mammon's normal attacks will hit for pretty decent damage, but its
biggest threat is its Petrification attack, which hopefully you've
prevented with either a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix, though it'll still
do a decent amount of damage, even if you did. It will also use a
Shockwave spell, doing quite a bit a damage to your entire party, as well
as Needlerain, a strong attack to just one party member.
Its Howling skill will replenish its HP by 500+ once it's near dying, but
lucky for you, Yuri's a powerhouse and will take that away and then some
in one round.
As usual, have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his
attack, then have him attack as normal. Have Halley use his Air Edge on
Yuri to increase Yuri's damage output, then have him cast Aqua Blade for
the remainder of the battle, unless he's learned Air Shot by now, then by
all means, use that. Alice should be healing as needed, using Blessed
Light when no healing is needed.

notes.text: If Yuri doesn't have his level 2 Fire and Water Fusions yet, I recommend taking the time fighting the Banshees and Larmgelgs here to get them. Having the Fire Fusion will help immensely in the upcoming boss battles. You may want to equip Pocket Watches while fighting the Larmgelgs.
The next boss uses Paralysis, and the one after that uses Petrification, so make sure each party member is wearing either a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix to prevent both.

As before, I recommend bringing Alice with you, mainly because the main boss the next boss is a Dark class. You can change your party with Meiyuan on Old Castle Street to whomever you want, if you wish.

Enter the Orphanage, then SAVE your game on the right. When you're ready, try
to go through the western door to trigger a scene and a sub-boss battle.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Night Stalker         |  2500 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Kid's Room Key       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  There's not much to worry about with this guy; other than boosting         |
|  himself up, his physical attacks do a decent amount of damage, but that's  |
|  it. Have Alice whoever is attacked.                                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit, using Ignition to boost his attack power, then  |
|  start wailing on the Night Stalker with physical attacks. Have Halley      |
|  constantly use his Strong Earth attack, which should do pretty decent      |
|  damage to the wind-based enemy. Have Alice keep everyone healed, using     |
|  Blessed Light when she's not healing.                                      |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'

After taking him out, open the door to the left for a scene, where you'll
receive the [_GUESTROOM KEY_]. Check near the bed in the lower-left corner to
find a [_SEAL OF LUCK_], then check behind the bed on the left in the middle
for a [_PURE EXTRACT_]. Finally, check between the two beds at the top of the
screen for a [_MONKEY PAW_]. Once you have everything, go back out into the
hallway.

Head up the stairs, then go right and down to find an [_EYE OF OUROBOROS_]. Now
make your way to the left side of the room, then down to find a
[_ZODIAC BRACELET_]. Next, head into the room against the upper wall, on the
left side. Examine the books on the table in here to do a Normal Ring that
spins REALLY fast, which will allow you to see the following date:
5, March, 75, so remember "5375" for later. Check the floor in front of the
fireplace for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then feel free to read the diary on the
desk at the bottom of the screen if you like. Leave the room.

Go over to the door on the right upstairs, and it'll ask for a password, so
enter "5375" from the picture's date to unlock the door. Check in front of the
fireplace in this room to find some [_MONK EARRINGS_], then check the desk
above the fireplace for another Normal Ring. After completing it, read the
master's diary to find out what's really been going on around here, then
examine the painting to the right of the desk, showing it was done on the
following date: 3 July, 54, so remember "3754" for the next password. Leave
this room, then SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     The next boss uses Paralysis, and the one after that uses
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Petrification, so make sure each party member is wearing either a
           Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix to prevent both.

When you're ready, examine the northern door in the center and input "3754",
then go inside. Watch the events unfold, and you'll have to take on Jack
himself.

      .————————————.

| Jack                  |  2500 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Seal of Speed        |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Jack will mainly just use his Paralysis attack against you, though you     |
|  should be guarded by a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix. He will also use     |
|  pretty strong physical attacks, and his Slash attack, which will do MAJOR  |
|  damage to one party member, so make sure to stay healed. He will use       |
|  Thera Seeds when his HP starts to drop.                                    |
|                                                                             |
|  When fighting, keep in mind that you have a harder boss battle right       |
|  after this, with no chance to heal.                                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then   |
|  have him attack as normal. Have Halley cast Strong Earth continuously      |
|  (not Aqua Blade, since Jack is water based) for the whole battle, unless   |
|  he's learned Air Shot by now, then by all means, use that. Alice should    |
|  be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed.       |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're comfortable at the end, take a turn or two to make sure          |
|  everyone is healed to the max and ready for the next battle.               |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   17000 EXP   / \   15000 Cash   /

After the battle, you'll watch a quick scene, then you'll be back at the London
Rats' hideout. After a few more events, you'll regain control.

Make your way all the way downstairs, saving if you wish. Talk to little Joshua
down here, who will ask Halley if he can have his slingshot.

MAKE SURE TO CHOOSE 1! If you choose 2, you'll miss out on getting a better
weapon for Halley later on.

There's one more item to be had at the Orphanage, so leave Old Castle Street
and go back to the Orphanage one last time. Go into the center room where you
fought Jack and check behind the wire grating on the right; you'll find the
[_DRAZE_], a better gun for Margarete.

That's it for events within the London city limits for now, so head back out to
the Britain section of the World Map, then make your way to the Calios Mental
Hospital.

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   main boss the next boss is a Dark class. You can change your party
           with Meiyuan on Old Castle Street to whomever you want, if you wish.
